_metadata.description: Expanded September 2026 target obligations; planned protocols are not execution evidence.

requirements.title: Observed provenance and degraded sources
requirements.description: When an observed query returns, TTD MUST identify its source revision or observation time, supported coverage, freshness and unavailable portions without reporting source failure as an empty healthy ecosystem.

validation.notes: Planned SOURCE protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Separate truth layers
requirements.description: When entities or relationships appear in multiple views, TTD MUST label observed, intended and proposal-local values independently and preserve their provenance.

validation.notes: Planned VIEWS protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: No false observed promotion
requirements.description: When a draft or authored graph amendment is approved or applied, TTD MUST retain observed facts as source-derived values until their owning source reports a change.

validation.notes: Planned VIEWS protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Cross-repository artifact scope
requirements.description: When creating a proposal, TTD MUST support scoped existing and new scenarios, resources, shared packages and project artifacts, including documentation, requirements, experiences, proto schemas and draft skill/program definitions.

validation.notes: Planned SCOPE protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Durable bounded proposal identity
requirements.description: When retaining a proposal revision, TTD MUST record repository identity, selected scope, artifact owner/kind, safe path, operation, base/proposed identities and dependencies independently of temporary compute.

validation.notes: Planned SCOPE protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Immutable review content
requirements.description: When a plan references a proposal revision, TTD MUST preserve the exact reviewed artifact bytes and authored graph delta despite later editing or deletion of draft compute.

validation.notes: Planned REVISION protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Material review and amendment
requirements.description: When reviewing a selection, TTD MUST expose target, scope, permission, interface and deletion changes, validation gaps and plan references; changed content MUST create a distinct revision rather than inherit approval silently.

validation.notes: Planned REVISION protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Owner-directed conflict-safe apply
requirements.description: Before applying selected entries, TTD MUST recheck relevant base identities, authority and dependencies, route effects through qualified owners and preserve unrelated concurrent edits.

validation.notes: Planned APPLY protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Durable idempotent recovery
requirements.description: When an apply operation is interrupted or redelivered, TTD MUST reconcile durable per-entry owner receipts using the same operation identity before retrying effects.

validation.notes: Planned RECOVERY protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Honest partial outcomes
requirements.description: If any selected entry remains failed, conflicted or held, TTD MUST expose partial state and authorized recovery actions without claiming global atomicity or rolling back over newer unrelated edits.

validation.notes: Planned RECOVERY protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Safe selection and content
requirements.description: Before importing or applying entries, TTD MUST reject escaping or symlink-escaping paths, ambiguous owners, overlapping selections, prohibited runtime data and secrets.

validation.notes: Planned ISOLATION protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Drafts do not grant effects
requirements.description: When content is drafted or opened, TTD MUST keep proposed skills/programs outside live discovery and refuse execution, network, billing, publication, commit or deployment effects without applicable authority.

validation.notes: Planned ISOLATION protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Bound foreground and background work
requirements.description: When queries, layout, refresh, diffs or retention work execute, TTD MUST enforce qualified traversal, response, byte, queue and concurrency limits and expose truncation and cancellation outcomes.

validation.notes: Planned SCALE protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Qualify supported scale
requirements.description: Before claiming scale acceptance, TTD MUST provide reproducible approved cohorts and latency, CPU, memory, IO and storage measurements including constrained hosts, cold caches and concurrent workloads.

validation.notes: Planned SCALE protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Discoverable development contract
requirements.description: When a fresh authorized development agent begins, TTD MUST expose operational targets, requirements, experiences, architecture, owner boundaries, setup gaps and discoverable sensor obligations.

validation.notes: Planned EVIDENCE protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.

requirements.title: Applicable evidence without acceptance takeover
requirements.description: When reporting development outcomes, TTD MUST distinguish missing, stale, simulated and applicable evidence and retain Swarm's authority over mandate acceptance.

validation.notes: Planned EVIDENCE protocol; no execution evidence. Add tagged deterministic and real owner-path tests as implementation lands.
